[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Llek Hawser''' was a member of the [[Corellian Security Force]], serving under [[Gil Bastra]]. Hawser conducted surveillance of [[space platform]] [[3DC/Green]], which was suspected of harboring [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathies.<ref name="HS" />
